etymology: Compound: the record-keeper (史) in service — the functionary: official.
mnemonic: The clerk the empire runs on — リ. 官吏: officialdom's old name.

etymology: Compound: the body's repeated steps (復) — footwear; the steps taken: to fulfill (履行), one's record (履歴).
mnemonic: Where your shoes have been is your résumé — はく. 履歴書: your footprints, formatted.

etymology: Phono-semantic: jade (王) + 离 (phonetic リ) — from Sanskrit vaiḍūrya via 瑠璃: lapis, glass.
mnemonic: The blue stone in temple names — リ. 瑠璃: lapis — heaven's glass.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 疒 + 利 'flowing sharp' (phonetic リ) — the illness that runs: dysentery.
mnemonic: The sickness with 利's speed — リ. 下痢: the traveler's dread.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 离 (phonetic リ) + bird (隹) — the bird slipping the net: to separate, leave.
mnemonic: The bird and the net, parting company — はなれる. 距離 and 離婚: distances physical and marital.

etymology: Phono-semantic: stone (石) + a phonetic (リュウ) — the yellow flowing mineral: sulfur.
mnemonic: The rock that smells like onsen — リュウ. 硫黄: sulfur — hot springs' signature.

etymology: Compound: rising (生) even as the slope descends — swelling high: prosperity.
mnemonic: The bulge in the graph — リュウ. 隆盛: the boom years.

etymology: Pictograph (simplified from 龍): the coiled horned dragon — dragon; the imperial beast.
mnemonic: The serpent that owns the waterfall — りゅう. 竜: your 滝 kanji's roommate; 恐竜: the fossil kind.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 虍 (phonetic リョ) + 思 — thinking ahead of the tiger: deliberation.
mnemonic: Thought with claws in view — リョ. 遠慮: prudence worn as politeness.

etymology: Compound: strength (力) taken under the tiger (虍) — the prisoner: captive.
mnemonic: Caught in the striped shadow — リョ. 捕虜: the POW term.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 尞 (phonetic リョウ) — those at the same fire: colleagues.
mnemonic: Same torch, same shift — リョウ. 同僚: the desk neighbors.

etymology: Phono-semantic: roof (宀) + 尞 (phonetic リョウ) — shared quarters: dorm.
mnemonic: One roof, many alarm clocks — リョウ. 寮生活: dorm life.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hound (犭) + a phonetic (リョウ) — the chase with dogs: hunting.
mnemonic: The season the hounds wait for — リョウ. 猟師: the licensed hunter.

etymology: Phono-semantic: eye (目) + 尞 'torchlight' (phonetic リョウ) — seen by full light: clear.
mnemonic: Torch up, doubt gone — リョウ. 明瞭: clarity, certified; 一目瞭然: obvious at a glance.

etymology: Phono-semantic: rice (米) + 量 (phonetic リョウ) — measured food for the road: provisions.
mnemonic: Rations counted before the march — かて. 食糧: the national stockpile word.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + 夌 (phonetic リョウ) — the great tomb hill: imperial mausoleum.
mnemonic: The hill with an emperor inside — リョウ. 御陵: the kofun's formal name.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 侖 'order' (phonetic リン) — the order among people: ethics.
mnemonic: Human relations, shelved properly — リン. 倫理: the ethics course.

etymology: Measure character: one-thousandth — the old fraction: rin.
mnemonic: The coin too small to drop — リン. 九分九厘: 99.9% sure.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + 粦 (phonetic リン) — the next settlement over: adjacent.
mnemonic: One wall shared, everything else negotiated — となり. 隣人: the neighbor.

etymology: Phono-semantic: jade (王) + 留 (phonetic ル) — the 瑠 of 瑠璃: lapis lazuli.
mnemonic: Blue held (留) in stone — ル. 瑠璃色: the deepest temple blue.

etymology: Compound: earthworks piled — ramparts; baseball's bases (一塁).
mnemonic: The diamond's four little forts — ルイ. 満塁: bases loaded.

etymology: Compound: threads (糸) strung field on field (田) — piled up: cumulative; entangling (累が及ぶ).
mnemonic: Interest on interest — ルイ. 累計: the running total.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 厉 (phonetic レイ) + strength (力) — strength whetted: to strive, encourage.
mnemonic: The push that sharpens — はげます. 励まし: the friend's job.

etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 令 (phonetic レイ) — the summoning chime: bell.
mnemonic: The bell that calls politely — すず. 鈴木: Japan's second surname, bell-tree.

etymology: Compound: held under the reaching hand (隶) — bound in service: slave; the clerical script (隷書).
mnemonic: The hand that never lets go of the collar — レイ. 奴隷: history's ledger of shame.

etymology: Compound (simplified from 靈): the shaman calling rain — the spirit realm: soul, ghost.
mnemonic: What the rain-caller talks to — レイ. 幽霊: the faint kind; 霊柩車: the hearse.

etymology: Pictograph: the deer (鹿) with paired antler-ornaments — graceful: beautiful.
mnemonic: The deer in earrings — うるわしい. 綺麗's formal ancestor — 華麗: gorgeous.

etymology: Compound: the harvests (秝) counted in days (日) — the almanac: calendar.
mnemonic: Seasons filed under dates — こよみ. 旧暦: the old lunar ledger.

etymology: Compound ideograph: little (少) strength (力) — falling short: inferior.
mnemonic: Effort minus wattage — おとる. 劣る: the comparison's losing side.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 列 (phonetic レツ) + fire (灬) — burning in ranks: fierce, intense.
mnemonic: Fire with discipline — レツ. 強烈: impact at full burn.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 列 (phonetic レツ) + cloth (衣) — torn along the line: to rip.
mnemonic: The seam gives way — さける. 分裂: the split, cellular or political.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hall (广) + 兼 (phonetic レン) — the clean corner of the hall: integrity; honestly priced: cheap (廉価).
mnemonic: Honesty reflected in the price tag — レン. 清廉: integrity, polished.

etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 柬 (phonetic レン) — worked in the fire: to temper, train.
mnemonic: Heat, hammer, repeat — レン. 錬金術: alchemy — 鋼の錬金術師's first word.

etymology: Pictograph: vertebrae stacked — the backbone; lent to 風呂's second syllable.
mnemonic: Two blocks of your back — ロ. お風呂: where the spine unknots.

etymology: Phono-semantic: fire (火) + 戸 (phonetic ロ) — the fire at the door of the house: hearth, furnace.
mnemonic: The fire with its own door — ロ. 原子炉: the reactor — hearth, escalated.

etymology: Phono-semantic: rain (雨) + 路 (phonetic ロ) — moisture settled on the open road: dew; out in the open: exposed; Russia (露).
mnemonic: The morning's fine print on the grass — つゆ. 露天風呂: bathing under the dew's sky.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hall (广) + 郎 (phonetic ロウ) — the covered passage: corridor.
mnemonic: The hallway of squeaky floors — ロウ. 廊下: run and be scolded.

etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 娄 (phonetic ロウ) — the storied tower: watchtower.
mnemonic: Floors stacked toward the view — ロウ. 摩天楼: the skyscraper, poetically.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 良 (phonetic ロウ) — the open wave: waves; adrift: wandering (浪人).
mnemonic: The wave with no harbor plans — ロウ. 浪人: the masterless — samurai or exam-repeater.

etymology: Compound: rain (雨) through the roof (尸) into water (氵) — seeping through: to leak.
mnemonic: The drip that finds the futon — もれる. 漏れる: secrets and ceilings.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 良 (phonetic ロウ) + 阝 — the young gentleman: son — the 〜郎 of a million names.
mnemonic: The name-ending of firstborn sons — ロウ. 太郎, 一郎, 桃太郎: the clan of 郎.

etymology: Phono-semantic: money (貝) + 有 (phonetic ワイ) — wealth passed under the table: bribery; to provide (賄う).
mnemonic: The envelope with dinner inside — まかなう. 賄賂: the scandal's kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 或 (phonetic ワク) + heart (心) — the heart led astray: confusion, temptation.
mnemonic: The compass needle spinning — まどう. 迷惑 and 惑星: nuisances, and the 'wandering stars' — planets.

etymology: A kokuji — made in Japan: wood (木) + 卆 — the bounding frame: frame, quota.
mnemonic: The wooden border around everything — わく. 枠: photo frames and budget frames.
